name: Dushanbe State Unitary Enterprise Smart City Data Center
notes: Municipal government data processing center (TsOD) inside the new SUE Smart City HQ building commissioned 2025-06-21, opened by President E. Rahmon; press reports >120 server racks and a 24/7 monitoring center. Uptime Institute lists the client with Tier III Certification of Design Documents (design certification, not built certification; per kursiv.media snippet). Certification fact = A (Uptime), commissioning = B (secondary press quoting President press service). Municipal facility, not a commercial colocation offering.

name: TJ-IX Dushanbe internet exchange
notes: Operational IXP (PeeringDB ix/4728, Dushanbe, Tojiktelecom-organized; methodology verified pass: 16 peers/610G, 2026-01-25 update) and Tojiktelecom official TJ-IX page. Interconnection facility, not a commercial data center - recorded per methodology as verified infrastructure and kept separate from DC counting; CDN/cache participants do not constitute independent DCs.

name: Tojiktelecom colocation / technology sites
notes: Official service page offers equipment placement at Tojiktelecom technology sites (colocation), including TJ-IX hosting, with 10G/40G/100G; Dushanbe plus nationwide sites. Service existence = A (operator official self-description); facility-level addresses/specs not published = U/C. Operator self-use exchanges and regional tech sites are not double-counted as separate commercial DCs.

name: darya.ai / Yotta Darvoz green AI data center
developer: darya.ai Ltd + Yotta Data Services (joint venture)
notes: Strategic collaboration agreement signed 2025-10-25 (Yotta official press release, A) to build Tajikistan's first green/hydropower AI data center in Darvoz; JV combining darya.ai local expertise with Yotta experience. darya.ai official page: current project 'Tajikistan AI Data Center', starting with 2 MW from two existing hydro plants, expanding up to 100 MW (company roadmap, A self-description). Status: announced/planned - no power connection, construction or commissioning evidence yet; 2 MW is roadmap start, not operating IT load (capacity_layered). Per methodology classified under districts under government jurisdiction (Darvoz); some media (kabar.kg headline 'GBAO's Darvoz') mislabel it - noted discrepancy. Trade press: DCD 2025-10-27 (B).
